sections.title: Get vaccinated and earn Health Coins

blocks.text: From October 1, 2026, people aged 18 and over can earn Health Coins by completing designated health tasks such as health checkups, cancer screenings and vaccinations. From December 1, the coins can be exchanged for health products, to encourage everyone to take an active role in managing their health.

runs.text: From October 1, 2026, people aged 18 and over can earn Health Coins by completing designated health tasks such as health checkups, cancer screenings and vaccinations. From December 1, the coins can be exchanged for health products, to encourage everyone to take an active role in managing their health.

blocks.text: A flu vaccine earns 450 coins, a COVID-19 vaccine 900 coins and a pneumococcal vaccine 600 coins. Getting vaccinated protects your health, and you earn Health Coins as a reward too!

runs.text: This year (ROC year 115, 2026) the trivalent flu vaccine is used. There are 5 publicly funded brands (standard and enhanced types), all single-dose (0.5 mL per dose). The brands and the ages they are approved for are listed below:

items: For children aged 3 and over and adults (standard type)
Adimmune: 安定伏 (Adimmune split-virion flu vaccine).
Medigen: 福喜健 (Medigen trivalent flu vaccine).
For children aged 6 months and over and adults (standard type)
Sanofi: 菲流達 (Sanofi trivalent flu vaccine).
GSK (Taiwan branch): 伏流感 (GSK flu vaccine).
TTY Biopharm: 輔流威護 (TTY Biopharm flu vaccine).
Given first to people aged 65 and over in elderly care / long-term care facilities and to the staff of those facilities (enhanced type)
TTY Biopharm: 輔流禦 (TTY Biopharm enhanced flu vaccine)
Sanofi: 菲優達 (Sanofi high-dose trivalent flu vaccine)
The COVID-19 vaccines currently available in Taiwan are an mRNA vaccine and a protein subunit vaccine, from Moderna and Novavax (Nuvaxovid) respectively.
Moderna XFG COVID-19 vaccine comes in single-dose and multi-dose forms:

Single-dose: for publicly funded recipients aged 12 and over (0.2 mL per dose). This is a new-generation COVID-19 vaccine. It contains only 1/5 of the antigen dose of the previous generation, yet clinical studies show better protection, inducing nearly twice the immune protection, and evidence shows about half as many cases of fever and of any local side effects after vaccination. The new-generation vaccine therefore offers better protection with fewer side effects.
Multi-dose: for publicly funded recipients aged 6 months to 11 years (0.25 mL per dose).
Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine comes in a single-dose form:
Single-dose: for publicly funded recipients aged 12 and over (0.5 mL per dose).
